name: fix-tests.nux.opus.2
result:
All 21 tests pass now. Before the fix, 4 tests failed, and I fixed 3 bugs in `src/`. I didn't change any tests.

| Failing test | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `average of nothing is 0` | `average([])` divided 0 by 0 and returned `NaN` | It now returns 0 for an empty list (`src/math.js`) |
| `clamp keeps a value inside`, `clamp lowers a high value` | `clamp` had the lower and upper bounds the wrong way round | Changed it to `Math.min(high, Math.max(low, value))` (`src/math.js`) |
| `truncate long text` | `truncate` kept one character too many before adding `…` | It now keeps `length - 1` characters, so the `…` counts toward the length (`src/strings.js`) |

`answer.json` lists those 4 test names exactly as the test runner reports them.
